highlights: Imports now live in Ignifire-managed storage, so removing the original source does not break your library.
Cloud tracks can stream instantly, download for offline listening, or remove only their safe managed download.
Cloud and downloaded indicators now appear across songs and albums, with quota-aware upload pausing.
What’s New and Updates now have clearer homes, alongside a cleaner Settings experience.
Deeper liquid-glass reflections and a new minimized media-key now-playing popup bring the interface to life.
notes: Adds managed music storage, streaming-first cloud playback, safe cloud download controls, quota-aware sync, a What’s New feed, dedicated update settings, deeper liquid glass, and a minimized media-key now-playing popup.
